company.name: Cora
company.shortDescription: Cora is a fintech company that provides digital accounts for small and medium businesses.
company.description:
Cora is a digital bank for self-employed and small & medium enterprises. The company is currently operating in closed beta and plans to launch its first product, a free SME-only mobile account. Cora will later release a portfolio of payments, credit-related products, and financial management tools that are currently being developed. They have developed a modern platform that offers a cheaper and simpler service, freeing entrepreneurs from the bureaucracy and repetitive work that usually involves day-to-day finance.

Cora was founded by Igor Senra Magalhães and Leonardo Soares Barbosa Mendes and is headquartered in São Paulo, Sao Paulo, Brazil.

productsAndServices.description: A digital business account for companies with an active Brazilian CNPJ, providing account management, transfers, payments, receipts, tax payments, and financial controls through mobile, web, and integrated accounting tools.
productsAndServices.name: Conta PJ (Business Digital Account)

productsAndServices.description: A Visa business card with debit and credit functionality, physical and virtual cards, spending controls, individual statements, contactless payments, and international acceptance for company expenses.
productsAndServices.name: Cartão PJ (Business Card)

productsAndServices.description: A digital collections suite for issuing and tracking registered boletos, Pix charges, payment links, and recurring or installment invoices, with automated customer reminders and payment-status monitoring.
productsAndServices.name: Cobranças Cora (Business Collections)

productsAndServices.description: A financial management tool that displays business inflows, outflows, balances, and future transactions in real time to support cash planning and operational decisions.
productsAndServices.name: Gestão de Fluxo de Caixa (Cash Flow Management)

productsAndServices.description: Business financing products that provide working capital and early access to receivables, including capital loans and advance payments on eligible boleto receivables.
productsAndServices.name: Crédito PJ (Business Credit)

productsAndServices.description: A paid Cora account plan that adds enhanced business-management capabilities, including greater billing customization and access to selected API integration features.
productsAndServices.name: Cora Pro

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
